_status: DRAFT, NOT ACTIVATED. Planning document for slice 6 (WF-044). Not a grant: do not pass this file to `wf grant propose`. No Grant Confirmation Block exists for it; the block hash is printed only by `grant propose` on the pilot ledger, and authority begins only at the owner's confirmation of that block (spec §3 steps 1-4).
_based_on: WF-022 rehearsal grant shape (wf022/zen c92340c, fixtures/results/wf022-zen/run_flow.py:104-109), updated for FIX1 (PR #56, dfd6e85) and for the WF-037 review finding L37-M1 (a replacement block must carry exactly allowed, max and expiry).
_notes: The live run needs one replacement (slice 6 item 3: staged kill -> stop-confirmed -> reconcile -> decide -> replacement bind at generation 2), so replacement.allowed must be true and max at least 1. bind.validate_bind refuses a block missing any of allowed/max/expiry (bind.py:179-195) and a replacement wider than the replaced binding (bind.py:434-437).

Bind order learned in the rehearsal: the coordinator binds itself with an explicit --path scope/** (WF022-F3: the default contract read_scope exceeds this ARS role); the reviewer is bound only after `delivered` (WF022-F4).

Grant confirmation format (owner action (c)): the owner replies with the grant id and the first 8 hex of the printed block hash; the coordinator passes them as `grant activate <job> --owner-hash <8 hex> --quote "approve <grant_id> <8 hex>" --turn <owner turn reference>`. T29/D-022: the code checks only --owner-hash, so the quote must itself carry the grant id and hash prefix.
FIX1 I3: every grant command also carries --db <boundary root>\ledger\wf.db.

_owner_must_choose.expiry: an absolute UTC instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ covering the pilot window only (not open-ended)
_owner_must_choose.replacement.max: 1 is enough for one staged kill; more allows further replacements
_owner_must_choose.replacement.expiry: UTC instant, at or before the grant expiry
_owner_must_choose.reviewer_paths: whether the reviewer role may read pristine/** (needed for AC6 comparison by eye; the check script reads it regardless)
